text:
sara: Quick async thread — token-cost attribution + event schema status. Need to lock owners and milestones before we freeze. PRs are waiting on reviews. @kevin @jin please drop current blockers.

jin: PR #2846 open for `attributed_token` event. Failing schema linter because we have `unit_cost` vs `cost_usd` in different places. I'll push a fix to the schema file today.

kevin: Which do downstream pipelines expect? I can adapt ingest mapping but prefer we standardize.

matthew: For dashboards I can work with either, but aggregations are easier if we keep `unit_cost` (float) + `currency`. Saves extra parsing.

jin: Agreed. Proposal: canonical event fields -> `unit_cost` (float), `currency` (string), `billing_tags` (array). Example schema snippet I'm about to push:

```json
{
  "event_type": "attributed_token",
  "properties": {
    "prompt_id": "string",
    "token_count": "int",
    "unit_cost": "float",
    "currency": "string",
    "model": "string",
    "timestamp": "iso8601"
  }
}
```

rowan: small note — make sure `prompt_id` is stable across retries. We had duplicates in last roll. Maybe rename to `prompt_hash` if needed.

kevin: I can dedupe on ingest if `prompt_id` isn't stable. But better to standardize upstream. I'll check with generation team on using `prompt_hash`.

telemetry-bot: CI: PR #2846 — tests/ingest passed :white_check_mark: (build 1123)

sara: Thanks. On latency: current dashboard shows p50 ~40ms, p95 ~220ms for token pipeline (after prefix cache). Does attribution add extra roundtrip or compute? We need an estimate for SLO impact.

matthew: Attribution done in-transform (no extra network hop). Estimate: +10-40ms depending on batch size. p95 might hit +30ms in worst case for small batches. I'll add panels to monitor.

jin: Confirm — join is local in the transform stage using prompt_id join; no external calls. CPU cost increases marginally but we should watch backpressure on small-batch traffic.

ella: SDK note — if the event name or field names change we need a minor bump. Please @mention devex in PR.

kevin: Owners and next steps I propose: Jin -> schema PR and tests, Kevin -> ingest mapping PR + deploy window, Matthew -> dashboard+latency panels, Sara -> final sign-off.

sara: Sounds good. Please confirm ETA: schema PR ready today, ingest mapping PR by EOD tomorrow, dashboards by Monday. Target GA next Tue (rolling) if no issues.

jin: Confirmed. I'll ping reviewers: @sara @matthew @kevin.

kevin: Confirmed. I'll open mapping PR and request infra for a Thu 17:00 PST deploy window.

matthew: I'll add two panels: `attributed_token_rate` and `attribution_latency_p95` and set alert at +50ms above baseline. Rowan and I will run an A/B on staging once mapping PR lands.

telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled Fri 02:00 UTC (job 7782)

sara: Great — I'll review the schema PR tonight and do sign-off Monday AM if green. Thanks everyone :rocket:

sara: Action items recap: 1) jin -> push schema fix & rebase PR #2846; 2) kevin -> mapping PR + infra window; 3) matthew -> dashboard panels + alerts; 4) rowan -> staging A/B; 5) ella -> flag SDK bump to devex. I'll check-in Monday for final roll.
